description: ContributionProof derivation: a ContributionProof is created ONLY from a verified bilateral receipt. The proof captures: receiptHash (BLAKE3-256 of the receipt signing payload), bytesForwarded (sent + received), durationSeconds (sessionEnd - sessionStart), contributorNodeId (= gatewayNodeId). A tampered gateway signature causes createContributionProof to fail — the receipt no longer verifies, and self-reported traffic creates NO proof (and hence NO credit).

sharedKeys.note: Public keys only — no secret-key material is committed. Keypairs were derived from fixed 32-byte test seeds inside the generator script for byte stability.

vectors.name: valid-proof
vectors.description: Create a BilateralReceipt via createBilateralReceipt (gateway signs first, then peer). verifyBilateralReceipt returns ok. Call createContributionProof — it re-verifies the receipt, computes the receiptHash, and emits a ContributionProof. Capture: receiptHash hex, bytesForwarded, durationSeconds, contributorNodeId.

vectors.name: invalid-receipt
vectors.description: Tamper the gatewaySignature of a genuine receipt. createContributionProof first calls verifyBilateralReceipt — verification now fails ('gateway signature invalid'). Per spec/11: a tampered bilateral receipt is a UNILATERAL claim at best, and creates NO proof. No ContributionProof is emitted.

expected.failReason: receipt verification failed: gateway signature invalid
expected.actualCreateResult: fail/receipt verification failed: gateway signature invalid

verification: Reference implementation: reference/economics/contribution.ts — createBilateralReceipt, verifyBilateralReceipt, createContributionProof, receiptSigningPayload.
notes: Per spec/00 §31 and spec/11: self-reported contribution → Civic Points is FORBIDDEN. A ContributionProof is created ONLY from a verified bilateral receipt (both gateway and peer signatures). Tampering either signature breaks the bilateral property and no proof is emitted. The receiptHash is BLAKE3-256 of the receiptSigningPayload (the domain-prefixed canonical CBOR of the receipt body), providing ledger deduplication.
